description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class and is used to specify filtering parameters (such as employee number and sorting field) for searching employee supervisor data within a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering employee supervisor search results, including sorting options and employee number filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'supervisor.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
